    • Method Detail

      • getRisk

        public String getRisk()
        Returns the risk level of the latest questionnaire (e.g. A5).

        The server does not document the scale, so do not infer an ordering between levels.

        Returns:
        risk level

      • getPi

        public int getPi()
        Returns the professional investor (PI) status code. The server does not document the code values; treat it as opaque.
        Returns:
        PI status code

      • getApprovals

        public Map<String,​String> getApprovals()
        Returns the approval states keyed by item (e.g. car, cka, risk_audit).

        Values are strings, not booleans: is_corporate_client arrives as "true" / "false".

        Returns:
        approval states, in key order (read-only); empty when the server returns none

      • getReAuthentication

        public String getReAuthentication()
        Returns the re-authentication flag, as returned by the server (empty when not set).
        Returns:
        re-authentication flag

      • getPiEndAt

        public long getPiEndAt()
        Returns the professional investor status end time, as returned by the server (0 when not set). Raw integer: the unit (seconds or milliseconds) is not documented, so it is not converted to a timestamp.
        Returns:
        PI end time

      • getDeadlines

        public Map<String,​Long> getDeadlines()
        Returns the deadlines keyed by item, as returned by the server.

        Raw integers with the same undocumented unit as piEndAt.

        Returns:
        deadlines, in key order (read-only); empty when the server returns none

      • getRiskAssessmentAt

        public String getRiskAssessmentAt()
        Returns the date of the latest risk assessment, as returned by the server (e.g. 2026-10-14).

        Kept as the server's string: the yyyy-mm-dd form is not documented to be guaranteed. May be empty; a null or absent value also decodes to an empty string, so emptiness does not by itself mean "never assessed".

        Returns:
        risk assessment date

      • getScore

        public int getScore()
        Returns the questionnaire score.
        Returns:
        questionnaire score

      • getStrategyRiskLevels

        public String[] getStrategyRiskLevels()
        Returns the strategy risk levels of the member.

        The server does not document what these levels permit, so do not read them as a trading entitlement.

        Returns:
        strategy risk levels
